title: Sharpness Loss for Radon--Nikodym Derivatives of Completely Positive Maps
summary: The Radon--Nikodym theorem for completely positive maps identifies the order interval below a map with positive contractions in the commutant of its minimal Stinespring representation. In this paper, we study the behavior of projection-valued Radon--Nikodym derivatives (sharp submaps) under composition. We prove that sharpness loss is determined by the multiplicative defect of the induced pullback map.
